currency_basis: Stage 1 hypotheses retained until conversion testing; not PPP claims.

form.owner_copy: Admin analytics/event only: pseudonymous session id, locale/market, funnel status, model version, consent flags and delivery status. Do not send raw health inputs, raw score/result or report link to the owner.
form.privacy_guardrail: Email delivery is service fulfillment. Marketing consent must be separate and optional. Retain reports briefly, encrypt at rest/in transit, use expiring unguessable links, and support deletion.

phase_1_validacion.activate_charging_when: At least 3 of 4 thresholds are met for two consecutive weekly cohorts and no material safety/QA blocker remains.

phase_2_cobro.ppp_policy: Recalculate quarterly from a documented PPP/local willingness-to-pay table before launch in each country; current values are commercial hypotheses from Stage 1, not verified PPP-derived prices.
phase_2_cobro.affiliates: Do not enable in health/wellness recommendations until conflict-of-interest policy and category safety review exist.

notes: US$0.0004/email is allocated average plan cost at 50k emails (US$20/50,000), not marginal cost inside the included quota; overage pricing differs.
Compute allowance is a conservative modeling assumption, not a published tariff line; actual Workers incremental cost may be inside included quota.
Excludes tax, FX, support, chargebacks, PDF storage, refunds, affiliate payout, and fixed hosting. Local payment fees vary.
At US$19 using Stripe US domestic standard pricing, payment processing dominates modeled variable cost.
